reviewMethod: Manual semantic selection from actual raw source PNGs and final packed-cell contact PNGs viewed using view_image; a maximum3px opaque-pixel snap follows the selection. Coordinates are local to256px packed cells. Crops are QA only and create zero new poses.

tomba_hero.emitter: spiked steel ball; gripping hand in overhead super preparation
tomba_hero.notes: Actual held spiked ball where visible; overhead super preparation uses the visibly gripping raised hand because the ball is occluded. No hair or chain-only point is selected.

charles_tomba.notes: Visible instructing hand/palm; seated recovery uses the resting hand. Civilian instruction, no damaging emitter.

tabby_tomba.notes: Visible clasped or extended rescue-signal hands; no weapon or offensive spell.

winston_tr.emitter: held tea service or open directing palm
winston_tr.notes: Visible cup/tea service, or open directing palm when the tray is held in the other hand. Support service only.

spyro_spyro.notes: Forward yellow horn in each quadruped horn-charge pose, measured on the horn and never on a detached effect.

spyro_sparx.notes: Leading golden head of the limbless dragonfly companion; no humanoid hand or attack emitter is invented.

spyro_hunter.emitter: bow-grip hand at arrow launch plane
spyro_hunter.notes: Visible bow-grip hand at the arrow launch plane. Detached arrow and streak to its right are deliberately excluded. Full-body corrective source reviewed.

rayman_rayman.notes: Actual white gloved physical fist on the retained complete Rayman drawing, including large forward fist in column2. Limbless anatomy is retained.

rayman_globox.notes: Visible acting palm; column2 super palm rests directly on the belly-contact pose. No detached cyan arc selected.

rayman_barbara.notes: Actual metal axe blade/cutting surface, including the overhead steel blade in preparation and complete forward axe in column2.

woodruff_hero.emitter: held blue-lens gadget or resting hand
woodruff_hero.notes: Visible held blue-lens gadget, or resting hand when the gadget is lowered; source-role puzzle support.

professor_azimuth.notes: Visible gadget operating hand or raised instruction finger. The source-role correction retains the actual held machine without inventing an offensive discharge.

master_boozook.notes: Visible green instructing palms or fingers, including extended route direction; elder support without weapon.

prey_2006_tommy_tawodi.notes: Forward rigid tip of the physically held alien rifle, before the orange muzzle flare; detached bright flare is excluded.

prey_2006_jen.notes: Visible unarmed civilian hand: reassurance, open rescue palm, or pointing finger. Corrected no-prop source inspected.

prey_2006_enisi.notes: Visible elder guiding hand/palm, with no fabricated weapon or damage emitter.

beyond_good_evil_jade.notes: Actual camera lens on the held reporting camera, including the opaque lens behind the flash. This is camera support, not a staff projectile.

beyond_good_evil_peyj.notes: Actual forward jet-boot toe/sole; decisive landing col2 is measured on the boot and excludes detached impact dust. Registry permutation is retained.

beyond_good_evil_double_h.notes: Actual armored leading fist during the heavy body charge; no center-of-body fallback.

metal_hellsinger_paz.notes: Actual skull mouth/upper tooth rim at the shot origin; the decisive open-mouth super uses its visible upper teeth, excluding fire inside or beyond the mouth and trailing blue ghost energy. Both retained corrective PNG sources reviewed.

dantes_inferno_dante.notes: Actual silver edge of the physically held full scythe. Corrected forward contact pose in column2, with no separate projectile.

dantes_inferno_beatrice.notes: Visible clasped/extended guiding palms of the nonoffensive apparition, excluding detached glow.

dantes_inferno_virgil.notes: Actual guiding hand/finger or clasped hands in recovery. No weapon or offensive magic.

shadow_man_michael_leroi.notes: Actual rigid Soulreaver muzzle at the front of the held bone gun, excluding the detached blue projectile and rings.

shadow_man_mama_nettie.emitter: held charm grip or advising palm
shadow_man_mama_nettie.notes: Visible held charm grip or open advising palm; source support props are retained and no offensive shot is inferred.

shadow_man_jaunty.emitter: guiding tendril or actual skull mouth
shadow_man_jaunty.notes: Visible pointing/raised tendrils of the nonhumanoid guide; the diagonal fatality recovery uses its actual skull mouth.

croc_croc.notes: Visible green physical tail, including the thick tail section in the spin; faint outer motion arcs are excluded.

croc_beany_bird.notes: Actual orange beak of the guiding bird; no limbs or projectile invented.

gex_gex.notes: Actual connected broad tail in the spin, excluding the detached thin outer motion arcs.

heart_of_darkness_andy.emitter: visible hand or wrist before blue life energy
heart_of_darkness_andy.notes: Actual visible orange palm or wrist before blue life energy. Fatality col2 fingers are occluded by the drawn energy, so the visible skin wrist is used; no white orb, beam or detached flecks. Permuted super col2 release retained.

heart_of_darkness_amigo_evacuation.notes: Visible orange guiding forepaw or flight-support claw, never belly center or wing motion trail.

rival_schools_batsu.notes: Actual skin-colored palm/fist for Super Guts Bullet; column2 origin is measured on the palm immediately before its gold projectile.

rival_schools_hinata.notes: Actual sneaker toe/sole for Fire Senpuu-Kyaku, including the raised shoe at the center of attached flame; no punch substituted for the kick.

rival_schools_kyosuke.emitter: skin-colored paired Super Cross Cutter palms
rival_schools_kyosuke.notes: Actual paired skin-colored palms for Super Cross Cutter; blue X beyond the hands is excluded. Preparation/recovery use the visible hands.

jersey_devil_jersey_devil.notes: Actual purple arrow-shaped tail tip, including the raised tail tip in the spin; bright circular purple trails are excluded.

tail_concerto_waffle.notes: Actual dark opening/rim of Police Robo bubble-control barrel; blue bubble beyond the barrel is excluded. Nonlethal capture origin.

tail_concerto_alicia.notes: Actual white gloved rescue-signal hands; pointing hand in col2 and open evacuation palms. No fabricated handheld device.

tail_concerto_cyan.notes: Actual white gloved salute, guiding finger or reassurance hand. Ceremonial saber remains sheathed and is not an attacking emitter.

redneck_rampage_leonard.notes: Actual double-barrel shotgun muzzle metal, behind the bright orange muzzle flare; no trace or detached projectile point.

metal_hellsinger_unknown.notes: Actual complete physical Terminus blade cutting surface in each stance. Red bald three-eye corrected full-body sources inspected; no energy trace selected.
